 City of Littleton employee’s disappearance ‘concerning’ as search for him gets underway, police say

 By: 
 Óscar Contreras 
 Posted

 LITTLETON, Colo. — A City of Littleton employee has gone missing, leading the city’s police department to describe his disappearance as “concerning.” 
 Tyler Barton, 38, was reported missing Monday evening after he never returned to home in Roxborough that day after leaving for work at around 5 a.m.
 top-stories.mp4 
 Police said his disappearance was “concerning and inconsistent with his normal behavior.” 
 Barton is believed to be driving a gray Toyota Tacoma with Colorado license plate BGM-P53.
 City of Littleton 
 Anyone who may have seen Barton, his vehicle, or has information that could help investigators locate him is asked to contact the LPD at 303-794-1551.
